basic_details.job_title: WCDC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Residential Superintendent, Office Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Two contract posts are open at Shakti Sadan, Jamui. They are one Residential Superintendent (Awasiya Adhikshika), reserved for women, and one Office Assistant (Karyalaya Sahayak). The Women and Child Development Corporation (Mahila Evam Bal Vikas Nigam), Jamui, has invited the applications under Advertisement No. 01/26. Applications go by email to [email protected] and are accepted only up to 5:00 PM on 10 December 2026. Applications received after that are not valid.

content_sections.heading: WCDC Jamui Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention an application fee.

rows.details: Women and Child Development Corporation, Jamui (Collectorate, Jamui), Government of Bihar
Residential Superintendent (Reserved for Women), Office Assistant
Rs. 13,349 (Residential Superintendent); Rs. 8,899 (Office Assistant), plus EPF and ESIC as per rules
Postgraduate in a listed subject (Residential Superintendent); Graduate (Office Assistant)
Maximum 37 to 42 years depending on category and gender, as on the date of publication of the advertisement

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are made by email only. Send them to [email protected] by 5:00 PM on 10 December 2026. Detailed information and the application format can be obtained from the district website, jamui.nic.in. Get the application format (prescribed form) from the district website https://jamui.nic.in . Fill the application in the prescribed format and mention the post you are applying for. Attach self-attested copies, in PDF, of your educational qualification and experience certificates and mark sheets. Email the application with the attachments to [email protected] so that it is received by 5:00 PM on 10 December 2026. To apply for both posts, send a separate application for each post. Keep a printout of the filled application with you. An application without the certificates attached will be rejected at first sight. Applications received after the deadline will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The pay column of the notice is headed "honorarium". In addition to the basic honorarium, EPF and ESIC are payable to the employees as per rules. Who can apply: the post is reserved for women. Educational qualification: Postgraduate in Law / Social Work / Sociology / Social Science / Psychology. Experience: at least 5 years of work in any government or non-government project or programme related to women's issues. Preference: candidates with work experience as a counsellor in a government or non-government project or programme related to women's issues will be preferred. Local candidates will also be preferred. Educational qualification: Graduate. Experience: knowledge of computers is required. The candidate also needs at least 3 years of experience in data management, documentation, web-based reporting, video conferencing etc. This experience must be at state or district level in a government or non-government / IT institution. Preference: for the administrative post, a candidate with knowledge of computer work will be preferred. The Residential Superintendent post is reserved for women, so the female limits in this table apply to it. Candidates must be citizens of India. The reservation provisions applied by the General Administration Department will apply to the appointments. The benefit of reservation will be given only to applicants who have Bihar domicile. Candidates with work experience in a government department, institution or office will be given preference. For experience in a government, semi-government or non-government department, institution or office, only an experience certificate issued by the appointing authority will be valid. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: WCDC Jamui Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints the work responsibility for the Residential Superintendent only. The Residential Superintendent will be responsible for the smooth running of Shakti Sadan as per the Shakti Sadan guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the prescribed format, mentioning the post applied for Self-attested copies (in PDF) of educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Self-attested copies (in PDF) of experience certificates. For experience, only a certificate issued by the appointing authority is valid.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates who hold the prescribed qualification will be invited for an interview according to the merit list. The final merit list for the posts will be published on the basis of the candidate's educational qualification, work experience and interview. Information about the interview will be given to the candidates concerned on the district NIC website, https://jamui.nic.in . The District Magistrate's office will not correspond with any candidate by post. The notice does not give an interview date.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in WCDC Jamui Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Residential Superintendent (reserved for women) and 1 Office Assistant. Both posts are Unreserved.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications are accepted by email until 5:00 PM on 10 December 2026. Applications received after this will not be valid.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Residential Superintendent post?
faq.answer: A postgraduate degree in Law / Social Work / Sociology / Social Science / Psychology is needed. The candidate also needs at least 5 years of experience in a government or non-government project or programme related to women's issues.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: A graduate degree and knowledge of computers are needed. The candidate also needs at least 3 years of state- or district-level experience in data management, documentation, web-based reporting, video conferencing etc. in a government or non-government / IT institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 37 years for Unreserved men and 40 years for Unreserved women. It is 40 years for BC/EBC men and women, and 42 years for SC/ST men and women. Age is counted as on the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The honorarium is Rs. 13,349 for the Residential Superintendent and Rs. 8,899 for the Office Assistant. EPF and ESIC are payable as per rules in addition to the basic honorarium.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form from jamui.nic.in and mention the post you are applying for. Attach self-attested PDF copies of your educational and experience certificates and mark sheets. Email everything to [email protected] by 5:00 PM on 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will be called for an interview according to the merit list. The final merit list will be based on educational qualification, work experience and interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract and entirely temporary. It can be ended without prior notice or on 15 days' notice, and there is no claim to regularisation.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Separate applications are valid for more than one post, so send a separate application for each post.
